# 2× from scratch — every flow · minute · e2e · every live year

**Date:** 2026-08-29  
**Status:** **HARVEST + DISK INVENTORY.** Do **not** implement. Do **not** re-run leftover injectors. Git only if asked.  
**Door:** [`2X-FROM-SCRATCH-READ-FIRST-2026-08-29.md`](2X-FROM-SCRATCH-READ-FIRST-2026-08-29.md)  
**Harvest / phases / year-true 18:** [`2X-FROM-SCRATCH-RESEARCH-GOALS-PHASES-FLOWS-MINUTE-VISITED-2026-08-29.md`](2X-FROM-SCRATCH-RESEARCH-GOALS-PHASES-FLOWS-MINUTE-VISITED-2026-08-29.md)  
**Law:** live tree + `SHIP_YEARS` + [`DISK-TRUTH.md`](DISK-TRUTH.md). Hub **1994–2024**. **2025 boarded.**

This file lists **every catalogued flow on disk** for every live year, dest by dest, with incomplete / complete / trap / key / Next. Generated from `flow-trails.js`, `flow-maps-3x.js`, `flow-maps-popular-3x.js`, `flow-trails-5x.js`, `e2e/2x-links.matrix.json`, and the live HTML.

**5k websites** = research envelope (ILS June table). **Not** dest count.

Serve:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Clear that year’s `ittYY-*` before a check walk. After a complete, only `ittYY-*` may appear.

---

## How every writer class works

| Class | Host | Incomplete (never writes) | Complete | Trap |
|-------|------|---------------------------|----------|------|
| **A Official / gold** | `html[data-official-key]` + year extras | empty · 0–1 honesty · missing pick | required ticks/pick + verb | named trap button |
| **B Leftover-official** | `[data-lo-panel]` | 0 ticks / empty / wrong pick | leftover key `{real, leftover, year}` | trap on panel |
| **C Popular 3×** | `[data-pop-go]` / `[data-ytl]` | empty / no pick | pop key | — |
| **D 4× leftover** | `[data-4x-panel][data-4x-go]` | below `data-4x-min` (default 2) | `ittYY-<suffix>` `{real, multiStep, year}` | leftover must not write gold |
| **E 5× extra trail** | dest in `flow-trails-5x.js` n=11–50 | same as D if a writer exists | same | empty `whenKey` = not a counted save |

Year-true 2× (harvest) = **18 leftover REAL sessions / year**, not the star write. Full matrix rows below that are continuity / d2 twins — leave them, do not grow them, do not treat as museum-grade A.
